}

```python
import narwhals as nw
from narwhals.typing import DataFrame
import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [500, 1200, 800, 1500, 900]
}

# Create a Polars DataFrame and wrap it with narwhals
df = nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(data))

# Add tier column using backend-evaluated conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# View results
print(df.to_native())
```
